cosy-lesson.title: Sitting Up Straight May Improve Your Mood (A2)

cosy-teacher-notes.p: Stage aim: to introduce the topic and clarify key target vocabulary for the session.

cosy-slide.cosy-instruction: Review the key vocabulary for this session below:

cosy-blockquote.p: Sit ≠ stand – to rest your body on a chair.

p.em: Example: Try to sit up straight while reading.

cosy-blockquote.p: Straight ≠ crooked – in a direct line; not curved or bent.

p.em: Example: A straight back helps you breathe better.

cosy-blockquote.p: Mood ≠ habit – the way you feel at a particular time.

p.em: Example: A walk in the sun can improve your mood.

cosy-blockquote.p: Back ≠ stomach – the rear part of the human body from the neck to the hips.

p.em: Example: Sitting slouched causes pain in your lower back.

cosy-blockquote.p: Chair ≠ floor – a seat for one person, typically with four legs and a back.

p.em: Example: Choose a comfortable chair for your desk.

cosy-blockquote.p: Energy ≠ fatigue – the strength required for sustained physical or mental activity.

p.em: Example: Sitting straight gives you more daily energy.

cosy-blockquote.p: Focus ≠ distraction – the center of interest or activity.

p.em: Example: Good posture helps students focus on lessons.

cosy-blockquote.p: Body ≠ mind – the physical structure of a human.

p.em: Example: Your body language shows how you feel inside.

cosy-blockquote.p: Health ≠ illness – the state of being free from illness or injury.

p.em: Example: Daily stretches are good for back health.

cosy-blockquote.p: Relax ≠ stress – to become less tense and more calm.

p.em: Example: Take a deep breath to relax your shoulders.

cosy-teacher-notes.p: Stage aim: pair/group discussion on core session themes.

cosy-slide.cosy-group-instruction: In pairs or small breakout groups, discuss the following questions:

ol.li:
Do you usually sit at a desk all day or stand while working?
★ How many hours do you spend sitting every day?

Is it easy for you to sit up straight when working at a computer?
★ Does your back hurt after a long work session?

How does your body posture affect your daily mood and energy levels?
★ Do you feel more positive when standing tall?

What exercise helps strengthen your upper back and shoulders?
★ Have you ever tried yoga or back stretches?

Do you have an ergonomic office chair at home?
★ Is your workspace chair comfortable?

How do you boost your physical energy when feeling sleepy at work?
★ Do you drink coffee or go for a short walk?

What helps you maintain mental focus while reading a long document?
★ How do you avoid distractions while studying?

How are the physical body and emotions connected in everyday life?
★ Do you notice physical tension when feeling stressed?

Why is good posture important for long-term spine health?
★ Have you consulted a physical therapist about posture?

What is your favorite way to relax your muscles after exercise?
★ Do you enjoy warm baths or gentle stretching?

cosy-teacher-notes.p: Stage aim: collaborative task or visual analysis in pairs/groups.

cosy-slide.cosy-group-instruction: In pairs, work together on the following task:

cosy-blockquote.p: A comparative reflection on our habits and self-perceptions.

cosy-teacher-notes.p: Stage aim: 1-on-1 guided visual description and task response with teacher.

cosy-slide.cosy-instruction: Look at the prompt and discuss your response with your teacher:

cosy-blockquote.p: A comparative reflection on our habits and self-perceptions.

cosy-teacher-notes.p: Stage aim: deeper debate and statement evaluation in pairs/groups.

cosy-slide.cosy-group-instruction: In pairs, debate and state whether you agree or disagree with these statements:

ol.li:
Sitting up straight immediately improves a person's mood and self-confidence. : Do you agree or disagree?
★ Do you notice a difference in mood when slouching versus sitting tall?

Standing desks are much healthier than traditional sit-down desks. : Do you agree or disagree?
★ Would you like to use a standing desk at work?

Maintaining good posture protects your lower back from chronic pain. : Do you agree or disagree?
★ Have you ever suffered from lower back pain?

Investing in a high-quality office chair is essential for anyone working from home. : Do you agree or disagree?
★ Is expensive ergonomic furniture worth the cost?

Physical body posture has a bigger effect on daily energy than caffeine. : Do you agree or disagree?
★ Would you try posture correction over drinking coffee?

Slouching while working reduces mental focus and causes cognitive fatigue. : Do you agree or disagree?
★ Do you slouch when concentrating hard?

Taking care of your physical body is the foundation of mental health. : Do you agree or disagree?
★ Do you prioritize physical exercise for mental clarity?

Schools should teach children posture health starting in primary school. : Do you agree or disagree?
★ Were you reminded to sit up straight as a child?

Taking a ten-minute break to relax and stretch every hour increases total work output. : Do you agree or disagree?
★ Do you take hourly breaks at work?

Changing your daily posture is the easiest way to elevate your overall mood. : Do you agree or disagree?
★ Will you pay more attention to your posture today?

ul.li: Incorrect: You should to sit straight. → Correct: You should sit straight. ((Modal 'should' is followed by base verb without 'to'.))
Incorrect: I feel my back hurts. → Correct: My back hurts. ((Express physical sensation directly: 'My back hurts'.))
